status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Dioura, Niamey and Mopti.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Dioura, Niamey og Mopti.

summary.en: Algerian forces have entered Niger to protect energy interests, joining other state actors in the Sahel insurgency. Islamist militants abducted 14 Islamic school students in Niger State, while bandits in the same state demanded over ₦100 million ransom for the abductees. Gunmen attacked a market in north-central Nigeria, killing four civilians and wounding five. A Russian electronic-warfare vehicle was observed operating in Mali. The conflict caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Algeriske styrker har gått inn i Niger for å beskytte energiinvesteringer, og slutter seg til andre statlige aktører i Sahel-opprøret. Islamistiske militante bortførte 14 elever fra en islamsk skole i Niger-stat, mens banditter i samme stat krevde over ₦100 millioner i løsepenger for de bortførte. Skytevåpenangrep på et marked i nord-sentral Nigeria drepte fire sivile og såret fem. Et russisk elektronisk krigføringskjøretøy ble observert i drift i Mali. Konflikten forårsaket 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known as the Sahel War, is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. The conflict mainly takes place in the countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
